summary: LVGL 9.5 on CM55, bare metal (LV_OS_NONE): display-dsi frame buffers (FULL mode, double buffered, stride 832), VG-Lite + software draw units, touch-ft5406 pointer, board55_millis tick; ui_init() / ui_poll()

patches.replace: \1        /* PSE84_SKILL_PATCH vg_lite_text: LETTER/LABEL left to the SW draw unit */
patches.why: VG-Lite bitmap-font drawing unreliable on PSOC Edge - text goes to the software unit
patches.source: own patch; behaviour as in Infineon mtb-example-psoc-edge-gfx-lvgl-demo (its lv_draw_vg_lite.c drops these cases)

patches.replace: (uint32_t)buffer->stride < stride) { /* PSE84_SKILL_PATCH vg_lite_stride: padded rows OK */
patches.why: display-dsi rows are padded (832 px stride for 800 px shown); upstream rejects any stride != width
patches.source: own patch; Infineon lvgl-demo removes the check entirely

patches.why: upstream 9.5 leaves src_type unused when LV_USE_LOG is 0 (-Wunused-variable)

source: own code; LVGL 9.5.0 (MIT, upstream via mtb://lvgl); guidelines (read, never copied): Infineon mtb-example-psoc-edge-gfx-lvgl-demo v2.6.1, E84_TouchUI, TESAIoT SDK lv_port_*.c
notes: text drawn in software, everything else may use VG-Lite; tiled images not patched (Infineon blits tiles - add if tiled images are used); LV_USE_LOG 0 (no UART on CM55); one context runs LVGL (main loop); CM55 main stack raised 4 KB -> 64 KB (LVGL runs on it in bare metal; Infineon's GFX task used 64 KB); lv_conf.h includes ui_conf.h when the app has one (ui-designer ui_gen.py: the fonts a generated UI uses); ui_stats().flushes counts frames handed to the display in flush_cb (2026-10-11: was counted in the flush-wait callback, which LVGL only calls at the next refresh - a static screen showed 0)
verified: 2026-10-11 tesaiot (second board, Waveshare 4.3" DSI), app lvgl-demo (dual, bare metal both cores): serial_test 9/9 PASS (display/GPU/touch OK, display IRQs ~110/s, frames flushed, 0 timeouts); full 800x480 frame rendered in 6-7 ms with VG-Lite; user saw the UI correct; 3 taps -> 3 button clicks at (174,210); slider drag -> 100 at x=791 (mirroring correct); 2026-10-11 lvgl-ui-app (generated 2-screen UI, 19 widgets): serial_test 26/26 PASS
